cards.title: AI correction, not yet a new bull leg
cards.question: Does Friday's bounce reverse four weeks of Nasdaq weakness?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Nasdaq -3.4% for Nov 2–6; fourth losing week, >10% below peak. HYPOTHESIS: valuation reset, not demand collapse. Upgrade only if SOXX leads for several sessions and estimates hold.
cards.prompt: Explain how to distinguish an AI valuation reset from an earnings-cycle downturn using 7/30/90-day evidence.

cards.title: Watch the market beyond QQQ
cards.question: Is capital rotating, or is risk appetite contracting?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: S&P -2.7% for the week; Friday chip index +4.2%. TEST: RSP/SPY, IWM/SPY, XBI and credit spreads. Broadening plus stable spreads supports repair; widening spreads rejects it.
cards.prompt: Build a falsifiable breadth dashboard comparing RSP, SPY, QQQ, IWM, XBI and credit spreads.

cards.title: Memory scarcity changes AI economics
cards.question: Who earns the margin when memory bandwidth becomes scarce?
cards.selfCheck: THESIS: HBM/server DRAM pricing favors MU and memory equipment; higher input costs pressure buyers. Watch realized pricing, capacity qualification and customer order changes—not GPU headlines alone.
cards.prompt: Analyze HBM, server DRAM, KV-cache bandwidth and the second-order impact of rising memory prices on AI deployment.

cards.title: 2026 capex becomes 2027 capacity
cards.question: Will last quarter's AI spending deliver revenue or idle assets?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Oct 2026 cloud earnings showed rapid Azure/AWS/Google Cloud growth alongside huge capex. HYPOTHESIS: 2027 commissioning and utilization determine returns. Watch power delivery, occupancy and cash flow; delays disconfirm.
cards.prompt: Trace October 2026 hyperscaler capex commitments into 2027 power-on milestones, supplier revenue and free-cash-flow risks.

cards.title: Inflation and AI guidance: two tests
cards.question: Which result would actually change the next 6–12 months?
cards.selfCheck: DATES: CPI Nov 10; NVDA earnings Nov 17; Fed Dec 9. Cooler inflation + durable AI orders favors repair. Sticky CPI or weaker AI guidance challenges it. Compare outcomes with consensus, not headlines.
cards.prompt: Create bull/base/bear scenarios for November CPI, NVIDIA Nov 17 earnings and December Fed policy, with company implications.

cards.title: Can suppliers outperform their customers?
cards.question: Will AI component leaders separate from cash-burning builders?
cards.selfCheck: PREDICTION (30 days): MU/selected optical and semicap outperform leveraged AI operators if orders hold. REJECT if supplier estimates fall, cancellations rise or relative strength fails despite stable credit.
cards.prompt: Design a 30-day evidence scorecard testing MU, optical and semicap suppliers versus financing-intensive AI infrastructure operators.
